name: skill-router
description: Smart skill activation by deterministic rules, no model calls: tells the model which installed skills fit the person's prompt (Italian and English patterns) and are not loaded yet, and holds a workflow, agent or cloud launch, a PR merge or a mod edit once until its prerequisite skills are loaded.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the lines you see in the transcript: it or en. What the model reads stays English.

gate.title: Prerequisite gates
gate.description: deny-once: hold a launch, merge or mod edit once until its prerequisite skills are loaded; the retry always passes. off: never hold.

suggest.title: Skill suggestions
suggest.description: on: name the skills that fit your prompt to the model (one hidden line) and in the transcript. off: no suggestions.
